curated.tagline: Terminal next-key prediction that learns from your own typing
curated.description: A terminal UI that draws an on-screen keyboard and predicts your next character as you type. Every keystroke and guess goes into a local SQLite log, so the model keeps learning from your typing. Two engines: a dependency-free character n-gram trained on your history, and an optional local model through llama-cpp-python. A companion daemon reads input events, computes rolling WPM and maps it to keyboard backlight brightness.
highlights: Character n-gram engine trained on local typing history, zero dependencies
Optional local-model engine via llama-cpp-python and a .gguf file
Every keystroke and prediction logged to SQLite for continuous learning
WPM daemon drives keyboard backlight from real typing speed
curated.architecture: Keystrokes → SQLite log → n-gram or local model → on-screen prediction; input events → rolling WPM → backlight

github.description: A terminal next-key prediction TUI with n-gram and local-LLM engines, plus a daemon that maps your typing speed to keyboard backlight.
